verses.text: Of David. Blessed be the LORD, my Rock, who trains my hands for war, my fingers for battle.

xrefs.text: He trains my hands for battle; my arms can bend a bow of bronze.
The LORD is my rock, my fortress, and my deliverer. My God is my rock, in whom I take refuge, my shield, and the horn of my salvation, my stronghold.
He trains my hands for battle; my arms can bend a bow of bronze.
For it was not by their sword that they took the land; their arm did not bring them victory. It was by Your right hand, Your arm, and the light of Your face, because You favored them.
Finally, be strong in the Lord and in His mighty power.

verses.text: He is my steadfast love and my fortress, my stronghold and my deliverer. He is my shield, in whom I take refuge, who subdues peoples under me.

xrefs.text: He said: “The LORD is my rock, my fortress, and my deliverer.
I will say to the LORD, “You are my refuge and my fortress, my God, in whom I trust.”
The LORD is my rock, my fortress, and my deliverer. My God is my rock, in whom I take refuge, my shield, and the horn of my salvation, my stronghold.
I will keep watch for You, O my strength, because You, O God, are my fortress.
the God who avenges me and subdues nations beneath me,

verses.text: O LORD, what is man, that You regard him, the son of man that You think of him?

xrefs.text: what is man that You are mindful of him, or the son of man that You care for him?
What is man that You should exalt him, that You should set Your heart upon him,
But somewhere it is testified in these words: “What is man that You are mindful of him, or the son of man that You care for him?
Put not your trust in princes, in mortal man, who cannot save.
What is man, that he should be pure, or one born of woman, that he should be righteous?

verses.text: Man is like a breath; his days are like a passing shadow.

xrefs.text: My days are like lengthening shadows, and I wither away like grass.
For we were born yesterday and know nothing; our days on earth are but a shadow.
I am fading away like a lengthening shadow; I am shaken off like a locust.
You, indeed, have made my days as handbreadths, and my lifetime as nothing before You. Truly each man at his best exists as but a breath. Selah

For we will surely die and be like water poured out on the ground, which cannot be recovered. Yet God does not take away a life, but He devises ways that the banished one may not be cast out from Him.

verses.text: Part Your heavens, O LORD, and come down; touch the mountains, that they may smoke.

xrefs.text: He looks on the earth, and it trembles; He touches the mountains, and they smolder.
He parted the heavens and came down with dark clouds beneath His feet.
Mount Sinai was completely enveloped in smoke, because the LORD had descended on it in fire. And the smoke rose like the smoke of a furnace, and the whole mountain quaked violently.
God came from Teman, and the Holy One from Mount Paran. Selah His glory covered the heavens, and His praise filled the earth.
The LORD is slow to anger and great in power; the LORD will by no means leave the guilty unpunished. His path is in the whirlwind and storm, and clouds are the dust beneath His feet.

verses.text: Flash forth Your lightning and scatter them; shoot Your arrows and rout them.

xrefs.text: I will heap disasters upon them; I will spend My arrows against them.
The LORD thundered from heaven; the voice of the Most High resounded— hailstones and coals of fire.
I will make My arrows drunk with blood, while My sword devours flesh— the blood of the slain and captives, the heads of the enemy leaders.”
For You will put them to flight when Your bow is trained upon them.
If one does not repent, God will sharpen His sword; He has bent and strung His bow.

verses.text: Reach down from on high; set me free and rescue me from the deep waters, from the grasp of foreigners,

xrefs.text: For the choirmaster. To the tune of “Lilies.” Of David. Save me, O God, for the waters are up to my neck.
He reached down from on high and took hold of me; He drew me out of deep waters.
Then the angel said to me, “The waters you saw, where the prostitute was seated, are peoples and multitudes and nations and tongues.
For strangers rise up against me, and ruthless men seek my life— men with no regard for God. Selah
He trusts in God. Let God deliver Him now if He wants Him. For He said, ‘I am the Son of God.

verses.text: whose mouths speak falsehood, whose right hands are deceitful.

xrefs.text: They lie to one another; they speak with flattering lips and a double heart.
My visitor speaks falsehood; he gathers slander in his heart; he goes out and spreads it abroad.
He feeds on ashes. His deluded heart has led him astray, and he cannot deliver himself or say, “Is not this thing in my right hand a lie?”
They fully intend to cast him down from his lofty perch; they delight in lies; with their mouths they bless, but inwardly they curse. Selah
The wicked are estranged from the womb; the liars go astray from birth.

verses.text: I will sing to You a new song, O God; on a harp of ten strings I will make music to You—

xrefs.text: Praise the LORD with the harp; make music to Him with ten strings.
He put a new song in my mouth, a hymn of praise to our God. Many will see and fear and put their trust in the LORD.
Praise Him with the sound of the horn; praise Him with the harp and lyre.
For the choirmaster. According to Gittith. Of Asaph. Sing for joy to God our strength; make a joyful noise to the God of Jacob.
Hallelujah! Sing to the LORD a new song— His praise in the assembly of the godly.

verses.text: to Him who gives victory to kings, who frees His servant David from the deadly sword.

xrefs.text: Great salvation He brings to His king. He shows loving devotion to His anointed, to David and his descendants forever.
O GOD the Lord, the strength of my salvation, You shield my head in the day of battle.
No king is saved by his vast army; no warrior is delivered by his great strength.
Then he placed garrisons in Aram of Damascus, and the Arameans became subject to David and brought him tribute. So the LORD made David victorious wherever he went.
So David inquired of the LORD, “Should I go up against the Philistines? Will You deliver them into my hand?” “Go up,” replied the LORD, “for I will surely deliver the Philistines into your hand.”

verses.text: Set me free and rescue me from the grasp of foreigners, whose mouths speak falsehood, whose right hands are deceitful.

xrefs.text: Reach down from on high; set me free and rescue me from the deep waters, from the grasp of foreigners,
He feeds on ashes. His deluded heart has led him astray, and he cannot deliver himself or say, “Is not this thing in my right hand a lie?”
They lie to one another; they speak with flattering lips and a double heart.
As King David approached Bahurim, a man from the family of the house of Saul was just coming out. His name was Shimei son of Gera, and as he approached, he kept yelling out curses.

When the Ammonites realized that they had become a stench to David, they hired twenty thousand Aramean foot soldiers from Beth-rehob and Zoba, as well as a thousand men from the king of Maacah and twelve thousand men from Tob.

verses.text: Then our sons will be like plants nurtured in their youth, our daughters like corner pillars carved to adorn a palace.

xrefs.text: Your wife will be like a fruitful vine flourishing within your house, your sons like olive shoots sitting around your table.
For I will pour water on the thirsty land, and currents on the dry ground. I will pour out My Spirit on your descendants, and My blessing on your offspring.
Your beauty should not come from outward adornment, such as braided hair or gold jewelry or fine clothes,
May the LORD give you increase, both you and your children.
No women as beautiful as Job’s daughters could be found in all the land, and their father granted them an inheritance among their brothers.

verses.text: Our storehouses will be full, supplying all manner of produce; our flocks will bring forth thousands, tens of thousands in our fields.

xrefs.text: He will love you and bless you and multiply you. He will bless the fruit of your womb and the produce of your land— your grain, new wine, and oil, the young of your herds and the lambs of your flocks— in the land that He swore to your fathers to give you.
The LORD will decree a blessing on your barns and on everything to which you put your hand; the LORD your God will bless you in the land He is giving you.
You will still be eating the old supply of grain when you need to clear it out to make room for the new.
The fruit of your womb will be blessed, as well as the produce of your land and the offspring of your livestock— the calves of your herds and the lambs of your flocks.
Your threshing will continue until the grape harvest, and the grape harvest will continue until sowing time; you will have your fill of food to eat and will dwell securely in your land.

verses.text: Our oxen will bear great loads. There will be no breach in the walls, no going into captivity, and no cry of lament in our streets.

xrefs.text: This is what the LORD says: “I will return to Zion and dwell in Jerusalem. Then Jerusalem will be called the City of Truth, and the mountain of the LORD of Hosts will be called the Holy Mountain.”
The LORD will cause the enemies who rise up against you to be defeated before you. They will march out against you in one direction but flee from you in seven.
But if you do not listen, I will weep in secret because of your pride. My eyes will overflow with tears, because the LORD’s flock has been taken captive.
Whenever the Israelites planted their crops, the Midianites, Amalekites, and other people of the east would come up and invade them,
“Judah mourns and her gates languish. Her people wail for the land, and a cry goes up from Jerusalem.

verses.text: Blessed are the people of whom this is so; blessed are the people whose God is the LORD.

xrefs.text: Blessed is the nation whose God is the LORD, the people He has chosen as His inheritance!
Blessed is he whose help is the God of Jacob, whose hope is in the LORD his God,
Blessed be the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, who has blessed us in Christ with every spiritual blessing in the heavenly realms.

Blessed are you, O Israel! Who is like you, a people saved by the LORD? He is the shield that protects you, the sword in which you boast. Your enemies will cower before you, and you shall trample their high places.”
Blessed is the one You choose and bring near to dwell in Your courts! We are filled with the goodness of Your house, the holiness of Your temple.
